from genty.genty_args import GentyArgs

    args_instance = GentyArgs()

import pytest
from genty.genty_args import GentyArgs

def test_gentyargs_no_arguments():
    args_instance = GentyArgs()
    assert args_instance.args == ()
    assert args_instance.kwargs == {}

def test_gentyargs_positional_only():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance.args == (1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance.kwargs == {}

def test_gentyargs_keyword_only():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance.args == ()
    assert args_instance.kwargs == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_gentyargs_positional_and_keyword():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, 3, name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance.args == (1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance.kwargs == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_gentyargs_mixed_types():
    args_instance = GentyArgs("string", 42, [1, 2, 3], name="Bob", flag=True)
    assert args_instance.args == ("string", 42, [1, 2, 3])
    assert args_instance.kwargs == {'name': 'Bob', 'flag': True}

def test_gentyargs_kwargs_method():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance.kwargs() == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_gentyargs_iter_method():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, name="Alice", age=30)
    expected_iter_result = [1, 2, 'name=Alice', 'age=30']
    assert list(args_instance) == expected_iter_result
